what: The native arm of the KAI scheduler four ways on the organism alone (omni-v25 runs 41809041712, 41810759693, 41812560443; the nativebare arm, which no Omni-Compass decision touches): the cluster's waiting pods from capture.csv (pods_pending, every reading) and the web service's 95th percentile response time in 10 s windows from latency.csv. The model gate's batch_flip model replays them, open loop, through both engines.
